title: Measure AI visibility for *free.*
sub: Google and Bing now report their own AI citations. The judgement calls are the part no dashboard makes.
readout: Before you buy a tracker: *two free reports*  ·  *five things your own logs already know*  ·  *five calls a dashboard cannot make*

columns.label: FREE · FIRST PARTY
columns.rule: The platforms report their own citations.

items.why: Impressions only, no clicks. AI Overviews and AI Mode.
Citations, grounding queries, Citation Share. Copilot, not ChatGPT.

columns.rule: Nobody sells you this. You already own it.

Training crawl is not a live signal. Citation fetches are.
